model_source: 85% adaptive acceleration diagnostic checkpoint, not accepted model
feedback_mode: only both original commanded vx and yaw exactly zero; 25-sample gate: cold reset first activates at decision tick24 / physical 0.48s, after an original command change at elapsed 0.50s
movement_behavior: freeze integrator, applied command correction zero; no altered user command for metrics
reset_behavior: processed action, low-pass sensor states and integrators reset to zero; history same original reset with real zero action
command_refresh: current frame command refreshed before CENet; all older frames retained with real command/sensors/processed-action timing
limitations: Flat rolling-contact odometry assumption; no proof for wheel slip or rough terrain.
No position setpoint; reduced net drift is not position locking.

feedback_gate_timing.definition: stable_steps increments before the first control step; a changed original command resets stable_steps to zero
